How the numbers work

Current rate is Saudi ÷ (Saudi + non-Saudi − excluded). Hires needed is (target × counted workforce − Saudi) ÷ (1 − target), rounded up, and assumes no one leaves. Replacements needed is target × counted workforce − Saudi, rounded up, with the workforce size unchanged.

What this does not tell you

It does not say which Nitaqat band you sit in, or what you need to move up one. Bands depend on your activity, your size class and the year, and the thresholds are set by the ministry.

Reserved professions and how your roles are classified can also change your counted workforce. Check both before you quote any gap figure.

What counts as a Saudi employeeVERIFIED

Since 15 April 2026, the Ministry of Human Resources counts only Saudi employees whose contracts are documented electronically on Qiwa towards your Saudization rate. Enter only those in the Saudi field.
